summary: Issue #607 silver orders/returns cutover: intent-review spec_fidelity=pass consumed as given. Migration 025 creates silver.orders/silver.returns with per-shop natural keys, revokes PostgREST client access, blocks legacy public writes via triggers, and retargets order_items FK. SilverOrdersReturnsPromoter + repos implement bronze→silver upsert; unit (3) and Postgres integration tests cover ACs. No reliability/security/performance blockers; A1 bronze-first orchestrator wiring explicitly deferred.

criticalFindings.description: Intent-review convention note (non-blocking): EtlConsumer still upserts via OrdersRepo/ReturnsRepo (silver-backed) rather than bronze append + SilverOrdersReturnsPromoter; full bronze-first ingest wiring remains A1 Speed per ADR-047.
criticalFindings.suggestion: Wire promoter into consumer/orchestrator in A1; no action for #607 scope.

criticalFindings.description: Migration 025 REVOKE ALL on silver.orders/silver.returns from anon/authenticated; schema-level PostgREST isolation is covered by #603 test_internal_medallion_layers_not_readable_by_postgrest_roles but no dedicated has_table_privilege assertion for silver domain tables.
criticalFindings.suggestion: Optional follow-up: extend integration test to assert table-level privileges on silver.orders/silver.returns.

criticalFindings.description: test_silver_orders_returns_natural_key_unique asserts duplicate insert failure for silver.orders only; silver.returns uq_silver_returns_shop_tiktok exists in migration/ORM but lacks parallel integration assertion.
criticalFindings.suggestion: Optional: add symmetric duplicate-insert test for silver.returns.

criticalFindings.description: Postgres-backed migration/integration tests (@requires_postgres) skip when DATABASE_URL is unreachable; implementation artifact notes CI lane may not exercise bronze→silver integration path locally.
criticalFindings.suggestion: Ensure merge-queue/full CI lane runs migration_heavy suite with Postgres.
